title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Explore Cornell University's campus without spending a dime. From world-class art and botanical gardens to historic library tours and sunset traditions, these activities are free for students and the public.

cards.title: Stroll Through the Botanic Gardens
cards.subtitle: 12 Plantations Road
cards.notes: Explore 35 acres of themed gardens and the 150-acre arboretum. It is open daily from dawn to dusk with no admission fee for students or the public.
cards.short_summary: A sprawling collection of gardens and an arboretum offering free year-round access to diverse plant life.
cards.evidence_claim: All of our gardens and natural areas are free and open to the public seven days per week year-round.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk. Parking is free on weekends.

cards.entity_name: Herbert F. Johnson Museum of Art
cards.title: View Art at the Johnson Museum
cards.subtitle: 114 Central Avenue
cards.notes: Visit this I.M. Pei-designed building to see over 40,000 works of art. Admission is always free for everyone, and the top floor offers panoramic views.
cards.short_summary: A prominent university art museum featuring global collections and iconic architecture with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission for everyone is always free.
cards.source_title: Visit - Herbert F. Johnson Museum of Art

cards.title: Listen to a Chimes Concert
cards.subtitle: McGraw Tower
cards.notes: Climb 161 steps to watch chimesmasters play the 21-bell instrument. Daily concerts are free and open to the public; check the schedule online.
cards.short_summary: Daily live bell concerts played by students in the historic McGraw Tower, accessible for free.
cards.evidence_claim: Chimemasters play daily concerts that the public is welcome to attend. Reservations are not required.
cards.access_notes: Check the online schedule for daily concert times, typically morning, midday, and evening.

cards.title: Watch the Sunset on Libe Slope
cards.subtitle: Libe Slope
cards.notes: Join a long-standing Cornell tradition by gathering on the grassy hill below Uris Library to watch the sun set over Cayuga Lake.
cards.short_summary: A popular campus tradition where students gather on a scenic hillside for sunset views.
cards.evidence_claim: Watching sunsets on Libe Slope is a beloved tradition for generations of Cornellians.
cards.source_title: Libe Slope, Friends, and East Hill Sunsets - Cornell Alumni
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space accessible 24/7; best visited at dusk.

cards.title: Tour the A.D. White Library
cards.subtitle: Uris Library
cards.notes: Step into the 'Harry Potter' style library inside Uris. It features three stories of ornate metal stacks and is free to enter for quiet study or viewing.
cards.short_summary: A historic, visually stunning library space within Uris Library open for public viewing and quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: The A.D. White Library is a large, three-story room within Uris Library... Cost: Free.
cards.source_title: AD White Library | Cornell University Library
cards.access_notes: Open during Uris Library hours; typically 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

cards.title: Hike the Beebe Lake Loop
cards.subtitle: Beebe Lake
cards.notes: Walk the one-mile loop trail around Beebe Lake. This natural area is located in the heart of campus and offers free access for hiking and birdwatching.
cards.short_summary: A scenic one-mile trail circling Beebe Lake, providing a natural escape on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Visitors can explore Cornell Botanic Gardens Beebe Lake Natural Area on the one-mile loop trail... open year-round.
cards.source_title: Beebe Lake Natural Area - Ithaca Trails
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Birdwatch at Sapsucker Woods
cards.subtitle: 159 Sapsucker Woods Road
cards.notes: Visit the Cornell Lab of Ornithology's 220-acre sanctuary. Admission to the visitor center and the four miles of trails is free for all visitors.
cards.short_summary: A world-renowned bird sanctuary with free trails and an educational visitor center.
cards.evidence_claim: The facility features a variety of exhibits about the science of birds and admission is free.
cards.source_title: Visit the Cornell Lab - Cornell Lab of Ornithology
cards.access_notes: Trails open daily dawn to dusk; Visitor Center open Tuesday-Sunday 10AM-4PM.

cards.title: Watch Ice Cream Being Made
cards.subtitle: Stocking Hall
cards.notes: Head to the second floor of Stocking Hall to look through glass windows at the Cornell Dairy plant. It's free to watch the production process.
cards.short_summary: A public observation deck overlooking Cornell's active dairy processing plant.
cards.evidence_claim: From an observational balcony above the Dairy Plant, visitors have a bird's-eye view of milk... being transformed into ice cream.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours, typically weekdays 8AM-5PM.

cards.title: Attend Midday Music at Sage
cards.subtitle: Sage Chapel
cards.notes: Enjoy free organ recitals and musical performances in this historic non-denominational chapel. Most Department of Music concerts here are free.
cards.short_summary: A series of free musical performances held in the university's historic Gothic-style chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: Midday Music for Organ... Free and open to the public, no tickets required.
cards.access_notes: Check the Cornell Events calendar for specific concert dates and times.

cards.title: Walk the Cascadilla Gorge
cards.subtitle: Cascadilla Creek
cards.notes: Hike the trail connecting downtown Ithaca to the Cornell campus. It features multiple waterfalls and is free to the public during the open season.
cards.short_summary: A scenic gorge trail featuring multiple waterfalls, connecting the city to the university campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cascadilla Gorge Trail is now open for the season... free of charge.
cards.source_title: On-Campus Natural Areas | Cornell Botanic Gardens
cards.access_notes: Seasonal access; typically open late spring through late fall. Closed in winter.
